title: Open 12.5
creator: CrossFit Games
description: Repeat of 11.6: seven-minute ascending ladder of thrusters at 100/65 lb and chest-to-bar pull-ups, 3-3, 6-6, 9-9 and on. Score is total reps. Masters 55+ used 90/55 lb and chin-over-bar pull-ups for women.

source.title: CrossFit Games Open 2012 – Workout 12.5
source.author: CrossFit Games
source.license: Public competition workout; description in our own words

items.name: Ladder 3-6-9… in 7 min
items.note: AMRAP 7: keep adding 3 reps per round (21, 24…) until the clock runs out. Score = total reps.
